en: Black‑and‑white photograph showing a long formation of mounted soldiers on a sandy parade ground. The cavalrymen wear dress uniforms and tall caps and carry upright lances with pennants. Several officers on lighter‑colored horses lead the column in the foreground, while trees line the distant background under an empty sky. No printed caption or writing is visible on the image side.
